src: Excisional lymph node biopsy shows effacement of nodal architecture by sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells, consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
must: lymphom tế bào B lớn lan tỏa

src: By the Hans algorithm the tumour is of germinal center B-cell-like cell of origin: CD10 is positive and MUM1 is negative.
The neoplastic cells show co-expression of CD5 and cyclin D1, and the mantle zone pattern supports mantle cell lymphoma.
Scattered Hodgkin and Reed-Sternberg cells are seen in a background of small lymphocytes, eosinophils and histiocytes; the features are those of classic Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis.
The bone marrow aspirate and trephine biopsy show a hypercellular marrow with 35% blasts, diagnostic of acute myeloid leukemia.
must: bệnh bạch cầu cấp dòng tủy
must_not: bạch cầu cấp tính dòng tủy

src: Marrow cellularity is about 60% with trilineage hematopoiesis, adequate megakaryocytes and no increase in blasts.
Perls stain shows 20% ring sideroblasts with dyserythropoiesis, in keeping with myelodysplastic syndrome with ring sideroblasts.
Reticulin stain demonstrates diffuse reticulin fibrosis, myelofibrosis grade MF-2, with clusters of atypical megakaryocytes; JAK2 V617F mutation was detected, consistent with primary myelofibrosis.
Cytogenetics showed the Philadelphia chromosome and RT-PCR detected the BCR::ABL1 fusion, confirming chronic myeloid leukemia in chronic phase, without progression to blast phase.
must: bệnh bạch cầu mạn dòng tủy

src: The bone marrow biopsy shows 40% clonal plasma cells with kappa light chain restriction, consistent with plasma cell myeloma.
The lymph node shows reactive follicular hyperplasia with prominent germinal centers and preserved mantle zones; there is no evidence of lymphoma.
Paracortical expansion with necrosis rich in karyorrhectic debris and histiocytes, without neutrophils, favours histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis (Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease).
must: viêm hạch hoại tử mô bào

src: Dilated sinuses contain large histiocytes showing emperipolesis that are S100-positive, typical of Rosai-Dorfman disease.
The patient has Ann Arbor stage IV disease with B symptoms, bulky mediastinal disease and bone marrow involvement; the International Prognostic Index is high.
must: chỉ số tiên lượng quốc tế

src: A starry sky pattern, a Ki-67 index close to 100% and MYC rearrangement support Burkitt lymphoma.
The peripheral blood smear shows lymphocytosis, and flow cytometry confirms chronic lymphocytic leukemia rather than acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
must: bệnh bạch cầu mạn dòng lympho
bệnh bạch cầu cấp dòng lympho

src: The marrow shows 12% blasts with multilineage dysplasia, consistent with MDS with excess blasts.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma and plasmablastic lymphoma are both high-grade neoplasms.
Acute lymphocytic leukemia relapsed in the bone marrow two years after induction therapy.
must: bệnh bạch cầu cấp dòng lympho

src: Flow cytometry of the marrow supports B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, which must be distinguished from chronic lymphocytic leukemia.
must: bệnh bạch cầu mạn dòng lympho

src: Persistent monocytosis with dysgranulopoiesis in the marrow supports chronic myelomonocytic leukemia.
must: bệnh bạch cầu mạn dòng tủy - mono
loạn sản dòng bạch cầu hạt

src: The cervical lymph node shows chronic inflammation, and the lymphadenopathy has followed a chronic course over two years.
The complete blood count showed pancytopenia, so a bone marrow biopsy was performed.
must_not: tổng phân tích tế bào máu
